name: Taiwan Optical Platform Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Optical Platform Co., Ltd. operates as a cable television system and channel licensing in Taiwan. The company also produces and distributes films; produces television programs; and provides investments, shareholding in cable television system operators, consultancy services and channel copyright representation, and other related endeavours. It is also involved in type II telecommunications; broadcasting and television advertising; wholesale and retail telecommunication equipment; management consulting; production of TV shows; general advertisement, retail business; program and advertising production; and management consulting.
